optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Software Engineer, Mine Fleet Dispatch System
professionalSummary: Dispatch software engineer at a mining company from 2021 to 2025, delivering algorithm and interface work for the fleet dispatch system against the mine operations specialists' specifications under the dispatch software standard. (src_9854cb98ba8d)

Carried the pager on the dispatch on-call rota for the whole four years across the three control rooms; the on-call log lists fifty-two night calls under my name, nine of them stopped-fleet incidents, each with the time to restore and the control room's sign-off that the fleet was moving again. (src_4e3246931971)
Every change of mine went through the mine simulator before review, with the simulator record filed against the change and countersigned by a second engineer. (src_61ee5017cc9c)
Changes went through dispatch software review and out on the dispatch software lead's approval, which the change record shows next to the checks that were mine. (src_5cd8e4715cc3)
Behind every change there is a boundary and hand-over note in the change record's closure section, stating what the change does not cover. (src_dd9d6e754fe9)
experienceHighlights: Delivered dispatch algorithm and interface work in line with mine operations specialists' specifications under the dispatch software standard. (src_9854cb98ba8d)
Carried pager on dispatch on-call rota, handling night calls including nine stopped-fleet incidents. (src_4e3246931971)
Proved each change on the mine simulator before review, maintaining simulator records. (src_61ee5017cc9c)
Submitted changes through dispatch software review, obtaining lead approval. (src_5cd8e4715cc3)
Documented written boundaries and hand-over notes for every change. (src_dd9d6e754fe9)
projectsAndWorkSamples: On-call log pages for nine stopped-fleet incidents with control room sign-offs; two change records with simulator records, review outcomes, and lead release approval. (src_336848a72ade)
skills: Documentation of boundaries and hand-over notes
